questions.text: Is there someone in your life you find difficult to forgive?
questions.verse_text: Forbearing one another, and forgiving one another, if any man have a quarrel against any: even as Christ forgave you, so also do ye.

questions.text: Do you struggle more with forgiving others, or forgiving yourself?
questions.verse_text: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.

questions.text: What does unforgiveness cost you? How does it affect your peace?
questions.verse_text: Looking diligently lest any man fail of the grace of God; lest any root of bitterness springing up trouble you, and thereby many be defiled.

questions.text: Have you experienced God's forgiveness for yourself? What was that like?
questions.verse_text: He hath not dealt with us after our sins; nor rewarded us according to our iniquities. For as the heaven is high above the earth, so great is his mercy toward them that fear him. As far as the east is from the west, so far hath he removed our transgressions from us.

questions.text: Is there a part of you that believes some things are unforgivable?
questions.verse_text: Wherefore I say unto you, All manner of sin and blasphemy shall be forgiven unto men: but the blasphemy against the Holy Ghost shall not be forgiven unto men.

questions.text: If you could let go of one grievance today, which would bring you the most peace?
questions.verse_text: For if ye forgive men their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you.

questions.text: What would it look like to pray for someone who hurt you?
questions.verse_text: But I say unto you, Love your enemies, bless them that curse you, do good to them that hate you, and pray for them which despitefully use you, and persecute you.

questions.text: Do you believe forgiveness means saying what happened was okay?
questions.verse_text: Dearly beloved, avenge not yourselves, but rather give place unto wrath: for it is written, Vengeance is mine; I will repay, saith the Lord.

questions.text: How might your life change if you released the people who've hurt you to God's justice?
questions.verse_text: Be not overcome of evil, but overcome evil with good.

questions.text: Can you think of someone who forgave you when you didn't deserve it?
questions.verse_text: And be ye kind one to another, tenderhearted, forgiving one another, even as God for Christ's sake hath forgiven you.
